name: Pythian Games
summary: Delphi's crown games for Apollo — music and verse before the foot-races — held every four years in late summer to mark the god's victory over the serpent Python and his taking of the oracle.
testimonia: Ovid, Metamorphoses 1.445–451 (Apollo founds the Pythian games after slaying Python)
Pausanias 10.7.2–5 (the Amphictyons reorganise the games; the laurel crown)
Calendar note: no baked Delphic peak yet — Olympics alone use olympicPeak in the Attic reconstruction; Pythia still awaits its own cycle anchor (not faked with annual conventionalDates)
